name: Write Project README
summary: Installs one portable skill for Codex, Claude Code, or both that creates complete project READMEs from verified repository evidence.
description: An evidence-driven, project-type-aware skill for Codex and Claude Code that creates or regenerates a software project's root README with portable installation and deterministic validation.

name: Ensure Social Preview
summary: Audits, creates, repairs, and verifies large-image social previews for web apps and websites.
description: An evidence-based skill for Codex and Claude Code that validates crawler-visible Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata, repairs framework-native metadata, and creates branded 1200×630 preview assets when needed.
uses: Open Graph and Twitter Card audits

name: Sync Project Metadata
summary: Audits and optionally synchronizes project identity and release metadata across authoritative local files.
description: An evidence-first maintenance skill for Codex and Claude Code that detects metadata drift across manifests, lockfiles, documentation, deployment configuration, and catalogs, then aligns local files only when requested.

name: Craft GitHub Release
summary: Turns verified repository evidence into trustworthy GitHub release notes and authorized releases.
description: A cross-provider release-writing skill that gathers Git history, manifests, changelogs, and validation evidence, drafts user-focused notes, and changes GitHub release state only with explicit authorization.

name: Verify Project Release
summary: Performs a read-only audit across GitHub releases, npm packages, tags, CI, and install commands.
description: A release-verification skill for Codex and Claude Code that compares local Git state, GitHub tags and releases, npm versions and dist-tags, CI evidence, advertised commands, and optional catalog records without changing release state.

name: Prepare GitHub Project
summary: Audits and prepares professional GitHub repositories with explicit local and remote mutation stages.
description: A repository-readiness skill for Codex and Claude Code that evaluates identity, metadata, topics, community health, security guidance, CI, and Git state before applying authorized local or GitHub changes.

name: Prepare Netlify Deployment
summary: Audits and prepares reliable Netlify build contracts for static, SPA, SSR, and hybrid web apps.
description: A deployment-readiness skill for Codex and Claude Code that detects framework and runtime behavior, validates Netlify configuration and output paths, and prepares evidence-backed local repairs without implicitly deploying.
uses: SPA, SSR, and hybrid routing checks

name: Publish Skill to Skillfolio
summary: Adds or updates a verified Agent Skill in a local Skillfolio catalog and its synchronized surfaces.
description: A catalog-publishing skill for Codex and Claude Code that discovers the live Skillfolio schema, verifies source identity, updates one record, synchronizes README and sitemap data, and runs the application's existing checks.

name: Audit Frontend Consistency
summary: Audits visual and interaction consistency across frontend routes, states, themes, and viewports.
description: A frontend-review skill for Codex and Claude Code that evaluates typography, spacing, color, layout, shared UI, responsive behavior, skeletons, motion, and visible accessibility states while preserving intentional design direction.

name: Ship Agent Skill
summary: Coordinates validation, packaging, publication, release, and consumer verification for Agent Skills.
description: An end-to-end release skill for Codex and Claude Code that validates portable Agent Skills, synchronizes release metadata, inspects npm archives, executes explicitly authorized publication stages, and verifies public artifacts.
